meta.name: content-strategy
meta.description: When the user wants to plan a content strategy, decide what content to create, or figure out what topics to cover. Also use when the user mentions "content strategy," "what should I write about," "content ideas," "blog strategy," "topic clusters," "content planning," "editorial calendar," "content marketing," "content roadmap," "what content should I create," "blog topics," "content pillars," or "I don't know what to write." Use this whenever someone needs help deciding what content to produce, not just writing it. For writing individual pieces, see copywriting. For SEO-specific audits, see seo-audit. For social media content specifically, see social.

copy.tagline_en: Plan content strategy and decide what to create
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide what content to produce, not just write it

howto.what: Claude 会帮你规划内容策略，包括确定内容支柱、主题集群、关键词研究，并按买家阶段和搜索/分享属性推荐内容类型。
howto.when: 当你提到“内容策略”、“该写什么”、“博客主题”等关键词，或需要决定要创作什么内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个SaaS产品的博客内容策略。
say.note: Claude会询问业务背景并输出内容支柱和优先级主题。

say.text: 分析这些关键词数据，找出内容机会。
say.note: 提供关键词导出文件，Claude会按主题集群和买家阶段分析。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you plan a content strategy: identify content pillars, topic clusters, keyword research, and recommend content types by buyer stage and search/shareability.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "content strategy," "what should I write about," "blog topics," or similar phrases, or when you need help deciding what content to produce.

say_en.text: Help me plan a blog content strategy for a SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for business context and output pillars and priority topics.

say_en.text: Analyze these keyword exports for content opportunities.
say_en.note: Provide keyword data; Claude will cluster by topic and buyer stage.
